title: Catalyst Africa Town Hall: Bridging the Gap for Continental Expansion

ms.promise:
Milestone 1: Identify underserved African communities.
・Research African communities with limited access to internet and other resources.
・Contact community leaders to gauge interest in CATH.

Timeline: 1-2 months
Tasks:
・Conduct a survey of African communities to assess their access to internet and other resources.
・Identify community leaders who are interested in CATH and can help to promote it in their communities.
・Organize meetings with community leaders to discuss CATH and how it can benefit their communities.
ms.criteria:
Milestone 1: Invest in translation tools and services
・Deliverables: A list of translation tools and services that have been evaluated, along with a recommendation for the best tool or service to use.
・Outputs: A translation budget and a timeline for implementing the translation tools and services.
・Intended outcomes: The CATH will be more accessible to people who speak different languages.

ms.promise:
Milestone 2: Establish partnerships with local organizations.

・Identify local organizations that can help CATH reach underserved communities.
・Negotiate partnerships with local organizations to provide support for CATH, such as space, equipment, and volunteers.

Timeline: 2-3 months
Tasks:
・Research local organizations that are working in underserved communities.
・Contact local organizations to discuss potential partnerships with CATH.
・Negotiate agreements with local organizations that outline the terms of the partnership, such as the scope of work, financial support, and duration of the partnership.
ms.criteria:
Milestone 2: Hold CATH awareness and onboarding campaigns
・Deliverables: A plan for holding CATH awareness and onboarding campaigns in remote areas of Africa.
・Outputs: A list of communities onboarded to the CATH.
・Intended outcomes: The CATH will be more representative of the diversity of Africa, including its languages and cultures.

ms.promise:
Milestone 3: Launch CATH in underserved communities.
・Train local facilitators to run CATH sessions.
・Provide resources to local facilitators, such as training materials, equipment, and stipends.
・Launch CATH sessions in underserved communities.

Timeline: 3-4 months
Tasks:
・Develop a training program for local facilitators.
・Train local facilitators on how to run CATH sessions.
・Provide local facilitators with the resources they need to run CATH sessions, such as training materials, equipment, and stipends.
・Launch CATH sessions in underserved communities.
ms.criteria:
The intended outcome of this milestone is to empower our local hub leads on Cardano blockchain technology and the evidence will be based on the number of local facilitators that we were able to train and educate on Cardano.
The number of Cardano wallets that we shall create for these people.
The number of facilitators who will be running and managing our various town halls in various languages. 
The resources that we will provide to these facilitators and the online blockchain submits that they will attend
